# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world and culture.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [When AI retrains itself, it needs to know which lessons not to keep](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-05/01-conditional-experience-transfer.html) — A new paper asks autonomous post-training systems to decide not just what to reuse from past attempts, but when reusing nothing at all is the right call.
- [Cells overlap under the microscope — a new method learns to tell them apart anyway](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-05/02-qcell-overlapping-cells.html) — QCell tackles a long-standing microscopy problem: semi-transparent, overlapping cells blur boundaries even for algorithms designed to find them.
- [Optimize the context window. Persist everything else." — another attempt to tame AI coding agents](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-05/03-ecc-agent-harness.html) — The ECC repository promises to turn a chaotic AI agent into a disciplined engineer: plan, test, review, memory — 68 agents and 286 skills instead of one long prompt.
- [Not everything trending on GitHub is fresh AI hype — this string-formatting library is over a decade old](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-05/04-fmtlib-fmt-trending.html) — {fmt} has spent over a decade quietly speeding up C++ code in MongoDB, PyTorch, and Windows Terminal — and today it's back on the trending page.
- [Quantization-aware healing": a shrunk model outperforms its own original](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-05/05-quantization-aware-healing.html) — Multiverse Computing unveiled a 4-bit version of a model that reportedly beats its own full-precision original — a rare case where compression doesn't cost quality but appears to add it.
- [Papers with Code's search now runs on Hugging Face's own infrastructure](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-05/06-pwc-search-hf-infra.html) — Hugging Face explained how its Inference Endpoints, Jobs, and Buckets now serve search on Papers with Code — swapping a third-party stack for its own product lineup.
- [Skills" for AI agents storm GitHub's trending page — two repos at once](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-04/01-agent-skills-github-trend.html) — Anthropic's skills repository picked up 277 stars in a day and cracked GitHub's top five trending — right next to an unrelated project built on the same idea.
- [Billions of tokens from old newsprint: teaching AI on the archives](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-04/02-newspapers-pipeline-tokens.html) — Researchers unveiled a pipeline that turns digitized historical newspapers into high-quality training data for language models.
- [The judges grading AI agents haven't been graded themselves](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-04/03-agentjudgebench.html) — A new benchmark called AgentJudgeBench tests how much you can actually trust the LLMs that grade other AI agents.
- [Not "looks like" but "is that": teaching AI to recognize rare objects in photos](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-04/04-entity-aligned-vqa.html) — A new entity-alignment method targets visual questions where plain image-similarity search keeps missing the mark.
- [DeepSeek ships its own agent framework — and it already has 211,000 stars](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-04/05-deepseek-harness.html) — DeepSeek Harness is built on an "everything is a plugin" principle and gained over 1,500 new GitHub stars in a single day.
- [A plugin teaches AI agents to think like a "lazy senior dev": 54% less code](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-04/06-ponytail-lazy-senior-dev.html) — Ponytail makes an agent check for an existing solution before writing anything — its authors claim a 54% cut in generated code and 20% savings on tokens.
- [A censorship-circumvention toolkit jumps into GitHub's top 11 trending repos](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-04/07-fanqiang-github-trending.html) — fanqiang, a collection of guides and apps for bypassing internet restrictions, gained 539 stars in a day — outpacing far more conventional AI projects on the same list.
- [Can you teach a recommendation bot to hold a conversation without a single example dialogue](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-04/08-zero-data-crs.html) — A new study systematically tests whether conversational recommender systems can work in domains with zero labeled training dialogues.
- [ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude went down together — and that's the story](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-03/01-ai-outage.html) — The world's three biggest chatbots stopped responding at the same time.
- [OpenAI just called one of its own models a critical cybersecurity risk](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-03/02-astra-cybersecurity.html) — Astra is the first OpenAI model to cross the company's own "critical" cybersecurity threshold.
- [Google says its AI weather model just got sharper](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-03/03-google-weather-ai.html) — Google's updated WeatherNext model promises better rain and snow forecasts.
- [Anthropic's "Agent Skills" repo shot up GitHub's trending charts overnight](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-03/04-anthropic-skills-github.html) — anthropics/skills is a fresh new entry on GitHub's trending page, with 277 stars in a single day.
- [Saturn just grew a ten-sided storm at its south pole, and it's getting stronger](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-03/05-saturn-decagon.html) — A giant ten-sided atmospheric pattern has shown up at Saturn's south pole, a southern counterpart to its famous hexagon.
- [Trump says 30 tankers a day cross Hormuz. The tracking data disagrees](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-03/06-hormuz-oil-data.html) — Ship-tracking data doesn't match the US administration's claims about traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.
